## User problem

Who encounters this problem, and what can they not do today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change and alternatives considered. Identify the
affected component and connection to the current roadmap phase.

## Acceptance criteria

What observable evidence would demonstrate success?

## Security and compatibility

Describe changes to authority, accounting, replay, privacy or operator trust.
State whether existing histories or deployed clients need migration. Do not
include sensitive vulnerability details; follow SECURITY.md instead.
